item.title: Bulletin updated at 21:15 HKT 27/Oct/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad band of clouds will bring a few rain patches to the northern part of the South China Sea tomorrow. A fresh to strong easterly airstream will reach the coast of Guangdong later tomorrow. It will be windy over the region in the following couple of days. The northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coastal areas of southern China gradually towards the weekend. The weather over the region will be slightly cooler in the morning during the weekend to early next week. Besides, the broad area of low pressure over the southern part of the South China Sea will move towards Vietnam today and tomorrow.
